[F006] All three iteration-1 findings are addressed. **Finding 1 (medium, correctness — whitespace-only body IndexError):** fixed in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify_buzz.py:224` by changing the summary branch guard from `elif event.body:` to `elif event.body.strip():`, so a body that strips to empty skips the first-line projection instead of indexing into an empty `splitlines()` result; added regression test `TestDelivery::test_whitespace_only_body_never_raises` in `test_notify_buzz_sink.py`, which asserts `notify()` returns a bool (True with the mocked CLI) and posts only the header projection. **Finding 2 (low, style — four Ruff violations):** resolved via `ruff check --fix` — import blocks organized in `notify_buzz.py` and `notify_event.py` (I001) and the two redundant quoted `"NotifyEvent"` annotations in `notify_buzz.py` un-quoted (UP037); the three changed files now pass `ruff check` clean. **Finding 3 (advisory — stale "Env: dev missing" claim in the implementer audit record):** acknowledged; no code change is needed — the Env declaration was and is present, and this iteration's reply declares Repo/Env/Project explicitly throughout so the regenerated audit record carries no stale advisory. Verification: the targeted buzz sink file passes 31/31 (including the new regression test), the adjacent `test_notify_event_f002.py` + `test_notify_discord_sink.py` pass 122/122, sanitization check passes (3503 files, no secret shapes), and Ruff reports all checks passed. No forbidden
